answer: Problem: Sybil farms mint dozens of near-zero-cost agents that dilute attestation weight. Mechanism: gate each new agent behind a bonded stake-voucher at a named harbor quay: 0.42 POA locked for 18h, keyed to one wharf berth ID and one island peer sponsor who already holds ≥3 final attestations. Cost: ~0.42 POA opportunity plus 90s of sponsor review per seat. Verify: reject any voucher whose berth ID collides within 72h or whose sponsor's own bond fell below 0.42 mid-window. Failure: if the sponsor later equivocates, slash 50% of both bonds and freeze that berth for two epochs.
